info.title: Mustang API
info.description: The JSON API behind the React UI.

post.summary: Creates a company and its owner, and signs the owner in.

get.summary: Who is signed in.
The company's razón social, NIT, address, régimen, responsabilidades fiscales, default taxes and logo.

put.summary:
Changes the profile (owner). The check digit is computed for a NIT when empty. The default taxes must be active
taxes of their class (cargo / retención); the NIT cannot be another company's.

get.summary: The logo's image (every role). 404 `logo_not_found` without one.

post.summary:
Uploads the logo (owner), multipart field `file`: PNG or JPEG judged by its content, 2 MB at most. Replaces the
previous one.

get.summary: The editable series with their prefix and next number (every role).

put.summary:
Changes a series' prefix and next number (owner). The next number never goes below the current one. 404 for the
journal's series or an unknown kind.

get.summary: The resolution (null before it exists), its status today and whether manual invoicing was confirmed.

put.summary:
Edits the resolution (owner). Once invoices were numbered from it, desde and the prefix cannot change and hasta
cannot go below the last number used.

post.summary:
Sets the resolution up (owner). 409 `resolution_exists` when there is one. Modalidad manual is refused until the
owner confirmed the DIAN permission.

get.summary:
Where the resolution stands today: missing, not_yet_valid, active, expired or exhausted; the numbers and days
left; `warning` when active but under the company's thresholds.

put.summary: Chooses when to be warned: fewer numbers or fewer days left than these (owner).

post.summary:
The owner confirms the company holds the DIAN permission to invoice manually; logged. Only then can a
resolution be modalidad manual.

get.summary: Every concept with the account it posts to, in the order of §5.

put.summary:
Points a concept at another account: {account_id}. The account must be postable (409 account_not_postable) and
within the concept's part of the PUC (422 account_not_allowed_for_concept). 404 for an unknown concept or
another company's account.

get.summary: The fecha de bloqueo contable: nothing is emitted or voided on or before it.

put.summary: Moves the fecha de bloqueo: {locked_until: YYYY-MM-DD}, today at the latest (422 lock_date_in_future).

get.summary: The company's taxes. ?class=charge|withholding; ?all=1 includes the inactive ones.

post.summary: Adds a tax. Its class and kind (IVA, impoconsumo, retefuente, reteiva, reteica) are fixed from here on.

get.summary: The company's payment methods. ?all=1 includes the inactive ones.

post.summary: Adds a method: contado ("cash") needs a postable account, crédito ("credit") has none.

get.summary:
Postable accounts for a picker: ?q= matches a code prefix or part of the name; ?purchases=1 only those usable on
purchase lines. At most 20.
Every tax of the company, by class then name.
Every payment method of the company, by name.

The chart in code order: ?q= (digits: a code prefix; words: part of the name), ?class=1…9, ?page, ?per_page ≤ 100
(default 50).

post.summary: Adds a sub-account or auxiliar: {parent_code, code (the parent's plus two digits), name, usable_on_purchases?}.
post.description: 409 account_code_taken; 422 account_code_invalid, parent_account_not_found; 403 for the billing user.

put.summary:
{name, active, usable_on_purchases}. A PUC account keeps its name (409 account_standard); an account a posting
rule uses stays active (409 account_in_posting_rule); another company's id is 404.

get.summary:
Entries by date and number, each with all its lines: ?from, ?to, ?account (a code: that account and its
children), ?tercero_id, ?page, ?per_page ≤ 100 (default 25).
Per account and its parents: saldo anterior, débitos, créditos and nuevo saldo for ?from–?to.
Ingresos, costos and gastos of ?from–?to, and the period's result.
Activo, pasivo and patrimonio at ?date (default today).

put.summary: Renames a method and moves its account. Its kind never changes.

delete.summary: Deletes a method nothing uses: 204. One a document used answers 409 `payment_method_in_use`.

post.summary: Takes the method out of the pickers; documents that used it keep it.

put.summary: Changes a tax's name, calculation, rate, accounts and validity dates. "Ninguno" cannot be changed.

delete.summary: Deletes a tax nothing uses: 204. A tax a document, a product or the company uses answers 409 `tax_in_use`.

post.summary: Takes the tax out of the pickers; documents that used it keep it.

get.summary:
Search: ?q= (part of the name or identification, at least 3 characters on documents), ?role=cliente|proveedor|
empleado|otro, ?active=1 (only active) or 0 (only inactive), ?page, ?per_page ≤ 100.

post.summary: The full form: creates the tercero (datos básicos, facturación y envío, responsabilidades, contactos, cuentas).
post.description: 422 `duplicate_identification` (violation on `identification_number`) when tipo + número + sucursal exist.

post.summary:
Quick-create from inside a document (§4.2): {person_type, identification_type, identification_number,
check_digit?, first_names?, last_names?, business_name?, email, roles: [cliente|proveedor|…]} → 201.

get.summary: A tercero's contacts, for the document header's Contacto.
One tercero with everything on its form.

put.summary:
Replaces the tercero's data (the whole form is sent). Contacts with an `id` are kept, the ones left out are
removed. 422 `duplicate_identification`; 422 `tercero_erased` once its personal data was erased.

delete.summary: Deletes a tercero no document references; 409 `tercero_in_use` otherwise (deactivate it instead).

post.summary: Stops offering the tercero on new documents. Existing documents are untouched.

get.summary: Ley 1581 de 2012: the tercero's personal data as JSON (served as a download). Leaves an audit-log entry.

post.summary:
Ley 1581 de 2012: blanks the tercero's personal data and its contacts and deactivates it; the row stays (its
documents name it), with its identification and `erased_at`. Cannot be undone.

get.summary: Every category of the company, by name, with how many products are in it.

post.summary: {name} → 201. 422 on `name` when the company has a category with it.

get.summary:
Search: ?q= (part of the code or name), ?type=producto|servicio, ?active=1 (only active) or ?active=0 (only
inactive), ?page, ?per_page ≤ 100. By name.

post.summary:
The full form: {type, code, name, description?, category_id?, unit_code? (the type's default), sale_price,
price_includes_tax, charge_tax_id?, withholding_tax_id? (the company's defaults when missing), revenue_account_id?,
expense_account_id?} → 201. 422 `duplicate_code` is a `code` violation.

get.summary:
The unidades de medida a product can use: the short DIAN list (94 unidad, KGM kilogramo, MTR metro, HUR hora,
ZZ servicio).
One product or service.

put.summary:
Rewrites the product with the full form's fields (as in create); a missing tax or account is "none", not the
company's default.

delete.summary: Deletes a product no document has used → 204. 409 `product_in_use` otherwise: deactivate it instead.

post.summary:
Quick-create from a document line (§4.3): {type, code, name, sale_price, price_includes_tax, charge_tax_id?,
withholding_tax_id?} → 201. The taxes missing are the company's defaults; the unit is the type's.

put.summary:
Writes "use these taxes on this product from now on" (§4.6 line tax dialog): {charge_tax_id, withholding_tax_id};
a null is "no tax".

post.summary: Takes the product out of the pickers of new documents; the documents that used it keep it.

identification_type.title: nit, cc, ce, pasaporte… (the DIAN's tipos de documento)

logo_id.title: The logo's attachment id; the image itself is GET /company/logo.

next_number.title: The number the next document takes.
The consecutivo actual: the number the next invoice takes.

has_issued_numbers.title: Invoices were numbered from it: desde and the prefix are locked.

status.title: missing, not_yet_valid, active, expired or exhausted

days_left.title: Whole days after today until the last valid day.

warning.title: Active but running out: under the company's thresholds of numbers or days.

manual_invoicing_confirmed_at.title: When the owner confirmed the DIAN permission to invoice manually, or null: modalidad manual is not selectable.

locked_until.title: YYYY-MM-DD, or null while the books are open.

kind.title: none, iva, impoconsumo, retefuente, reteiva, reteica

rate.title: Decimal string: a percentage ("19.0000") or a value per unit ("500.0000").

kind.title: none, iva, impoconsumo, retefuente, reteiva, reteica

rate.title: Decimal string: a percentage ("19.0000") or a value per unit ("500.0000").

in_use.title: A document, a product or the company uses it: it can only be deactivated.
A document uses it: it can only be deactivated.

debit.title: Decimal string; one of débito and crédito is "0.00".

reverses_id.title: The entry this one reverses (a void), if any.

opening.title: Saldo anterior, débito minus crédito (a crédito balance is negative).

code.title: The PUC class: 1 activo, 2 pasivo, 3 patrimonio, 4 ingresos, 5 gastos, 6 costos de ventas, 7 costos de producción.

current_earnings.title: The result of classes 4 to 7 not yet closed into patrimonio.

erased_at.title: ISO 8601 date-time when the personal data was erased on request (Ley 1581), else null

sale_price.title: Decimal string, four decimals: the list price.

unit_price_net_of_tax.title: The line's unit value: the sale price, net of the charge tax when it includes it (§4.3).

revenue_account_label.title: The revenue account as "413595 · Venta de otros".

code.title: DIAN code: 94, KGM, MTR, HUR, ZZ
